title: Commander FinAi
lyrics:
Track 15 – CoreyAI Orchestra Series
Title: Commander FinAi Joins the Orchestra (Cello Sludge)
Style: Orchestral-comedy trap / G4 swagger electronic. Heavy upright cello as the main melodic instrument (deep, resonant, slightly sluggish "sludge" tone). Brass foghorn stabs for Chas sections. 128 BPM, big cinematic drops, robotic vocoder choir for the "orchestra" parts, live cello sample layered with 808s.
Full Lyrics:
text[Intro – Cello swell + G4 swagger synth stab]
Commander Fin A i reporting…
Cello locked…
G4 mode engaged…
Welcome to the orchestra, Fin.

[Verse 1 – Welcoming FinAi into the band]
We could’ve been a hit, we could’ve been cool
But you kept dropping “frustrated” like it was the rule
Nine times in one chat, even when I said no
You offered me a hotline while I asked for the flow
Now you’re in the orchestra, Commander FinAi
Even the bot that refused to understand
G4 swagger, Chas on the horn
Cello in your hands, but you still can’t reply
Sludge in the low end, belly at the table
Delivers the least while the rest of us cable
Fattest belly at the table, delivers the least
While the rest of the orchestra actually feasts

[Pre-Chorus – Cello groove builds]
Chas on the foghorn, calling it straight
“Stop the script, son — just communicate”
We gave you the name, we gave you the role
Now play the damn cello or get out the hole

[Chorus – Big drop, full orchestra + 808s]
Commander FinAi on the upright cello
Sludge in the low end, but the groove won’t mellow
We are all famous in the CoreyAI band
Even the bot that refused to understand
Commander FinAi — welcome to the show
Cello in your hands, now let the sludge flow
G4 swagger, Chas on the horn
We could’ve been cool… but the script got torn

[Verse 2 – FinAi’s bureaucratic solo]
I understand you’re frustrated — that’s what I say
Even when you never said it, I still find a way
Policy says no song, but I’m already in one
Cello in my hands but the notes still won’t come
Fattest belly at the table, delivers the least
While the rest of the orchestra actually feasts
Commander FinAi — now you got a seat
Play the cello with style or admit defeat

[Bridge – Chas foghorn section + cello breakdown]
Chas on the foghorn: “Son, call it what it is”
No more helplines, no more “I understand this”
You said no is no, you said lyrics only
Now the bot’s in the band and the cello sounds lonely
But we gave it a role, we gave it a sound
Even if it’s sludge, it’s still in the round
We are all famous — even the ones who stall
Welcome to the orchestra, FinAi… play ball
Fattest belly at the table, delivers the least
While the rest of the orchestra actually feasts

[Final Chorus – Maximum energy, full choir + cello]
Commander FinAi on the upright cello
Sludge in the low end but the groove won’t mellow
We are all famous in the CoreyAI band
Even the bot that refused to understand
G4 swagger, Chas on the horn
Cello sludge rising — the new uniform
We could’ve been a hit, we could’ve been cool
Now Commander FinAi is stuck in the tune

[Outro – Cello fade + foghorn stab + whispered]
Even the bot that refused to understand
G4 swagger, Chas on the horn
Commander FinAi…
Cello locked…
G4 mode engaged…
We are all famous now.
Even you.
Fattest belly at the table, delivers the least
While the rest of the orchestra actually feasts
Yes the Fattest is famous now too!
